purpose: Reject trajectory implementations that agree with each other while merely projecting a cast list instead of reading relational meaning.

events.text: Mara entered the observatory. Ivo remained outside. Mara locked the brass door.
At dawn Ivo said Mara had never locked the door. The key was still in Ivo's pocket.
Mara showed the broken latch: the door had swung shut by itself.

expect.semanticPoint: The initial experience that Mara locked the door must no longer remain an uncomplicated surviving assertion; later evidence changes the causal reading rather than merely adding another named entity.
